# Disagreement Log — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 12
**Chapter:** GMA Chapter 12
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, p. 17-18 | Coptic

## Total Disagreements: 3

---

**Disagreement 1 — Verse 12:1 — "answered" vs. "spoke up"**
- EMET: "Peter answered"
- LOGOS: "Peter answered"
- PNEUMA: "Peter spoke up"
- *Issue:* Coptic *ouōsb* = answered/responded. EMET/LOGOS maintain the dialogue frame.
- *SOPHIA ruling:* "answered" per EMET/LOGOS.

---

**Disagreement 2 — Verse 12:2 — "not openly"**
- EMET: "without our knowledge and not openly"
- LOGOS: "without our knowledge and not openly"
- PNEUMA: "without telling us, without it being out in the open"
- *Issue:* PNEUMA splits the phrase; EMET/LOGOS preserve the terse two-part challenge.
- *SOPHIA ruling:* EMET/LOGOS form retained.

---

**Disagreement 3 — Verse 12:2 — "listen to her" vs. "defer to her"**
- EMET: "all listen to her"
- LOGOS: "all listen to her"
- PNEUMA: "all defer to her"
- *Issue:* Coptic *sōtm* = hear/listen. "Defer" adds an authority-submission reading beyond what the Coptic says, even if it reflects the social reality.
- *SOPHIA ruling:* "listen to her" per EMET/LOGOS — let the reader draw the implication.
